snippet.title: Megabonk Release Trailer
snippet.description:
My game Megabonk is finally Launching on Steam today! Go get it now :D
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3405340/Megabonk/

i just released the full game! This is the launch / release trailer for my game, Megabonk! I've spent 1 year developing it so far, and it has gone from beans to uuh less beans i guess. My game is sort of a mix between Vampire Survivors, Risk of Rain 2, and other roguelikes. There are randomly generated maps, and a bunch of different enemies and unlockable content. I'm making it in the Unity game engine. You should definitely wishlist Megabonk on Steam.
